note: Adds with_precomputed_query_vector: a caller-supplied query vector stands in for embedding the same query text with the context's model; everything after the embedding (lanes, fusion, tie-breaking, paging) is unchanged and the normal path is untouched when no vector is supplied. per_checkout_9 asserts the ranked rows and text are byte-identical to the normal path. Used by multi-repo parent folders to embed once and run child engines in parallel.
